def fitadd(c, k=12):
    cols=[np.tanh(c*T)]
    # polynomial basis in eps of degree k
    B=np.vander(eps/5,k,increasing=True)
    X=np.c_[np.tanh(c*T),B]
    co,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,sigma,rcond=None)
    return np.sqrt(np.mean((X@co-sigma)**2)), co
for c in [0.3,0.5,0.55,0.6,0.8,1.0]:
